name: Headwater Farms
notes: We are a farm located in the Rocky Mountains of Colorado, growing fresh produce, flower fields and a pumpkin patch. We aim to interconnect nature and humanity through agriculture.

name: Mushroom Love Co
notes: Mushroom Love Co is a gourmet mushroom farm located right here in the high rockies! We provide oyster and lions mane mushrooms for restaurants, markets and individuals. We also have mushroom growing supplies and classes available.

name: Valley Roots Food Hub
notes: Valley Roots Food Hub is a local food aggregator and distributor based in Mosca, CO, and serving much of our great state of Colorado including Chaffee County! We serve individual customers at home looking for grocery shopping needs, as well as grocers, restaurants, caterers, buying clubs, schools, food banks, & more! name: Rio Grande Organic Growers COOP
category: U-Pick, CSA Farm, Garden Center / Greenhouse, On-Farm / Ranch Sales
notes: The Rio Grande Growers are a farmer cooperative that cultivates about 5 acres located at the Rio Grande Farm Park in Alamosa, CO.  We do not use any pesticides or chemicals on our plants, only natural organic compost and weed by hand in small acre plots. From July to September we sell fresh produce and herbs to markets.

name: Gentle Earth Farm
notes: Woman-owned and operated organic vegetable farm located on 1/6 acre in Arvada, CO. We offer CSA shares, wholesale, and an onsite community farmstand.

name: Grow Girl Organics
months_open: May, June, July, August, September, October
notes: We grow organically. We do not use any pesticides. We grow a wide variety of wonderful nutrient dense food!
